prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 81.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.7%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 82.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 68.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Account Sync & Pet Recovery Hint', 'Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome', 'Desktop Ready Status Notification Indicator', 'Sign In Account Protection Spotlight Redesign', 'Multi Device Pet Sync Account Hint', 'Two Column Path Selection Screen']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Split Screen Live Pet Preview', 'Waiting Screen Progress Bar & Time Estimate', 'Two Column Photo Upload Guidelines', 'Sign In Account Recovery Hint', 'Desktop Display Readiness Alert', 'Desktop Pet Quick Controls Overview Screen', 'Account Cloud Backup Safeguard Hint', 'Waiting Screen Audio & Tip Carousel', 'Desktop Pet Visibility Preview Screen', 'Grid Layout for Path Selection', 'Account Sync Reassurance Banner', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference Component', 'Sign In Account Checklist Layout', 'Desktop Controls Summary Screen', 'Story Screen Fast Decision Copy', 'Pick Friend Choice Cards Grid', 'Waiting Step Counter & Progress Indicator', 'Desktop Controls Primer Welcome Screen Redesign', 'Desktop Wait Status Tip Carousel Notification', 'Pick Friend Character Choice Carousel Layout', 'Story Screen Full Bleed Preview Redesign', 'Split Layout Home Welcome Overview', 'Spotlight Layout Photo Upload Redesign', 'Desktop Display Readiness Sound Notification']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Move Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Interactive Controls Guide Screen', 'Interactive Pet Hatching Wait Flow', 'Path Selection Starter Benefits Banner', 'Adoption Certificate Customizer Grid', 'Story Scroll Path Showcase', 'Stage Layout Desktop Wait Preview', 'Path Selection Starter Perks Tip', 'Pet Selection Starter Companion Badge', 'Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation', 'Story Scroll Path Selection Flow', 'Centered Sign In Security & Pet Safety Layout', 'Photo Upload Guidelines Text & Hint', 'Carousel Layout for Choose Path Screen', 'Pet Adoption Flow Sequence Reorder', 'Adoption Certificate Stamp Redesign', 'Custom Photo Upload Tips and Validation Hint', 'Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign', 'Pet Trait Confirmation New Screen', 'Choose Path Welcome Story Reorder Flow', 'Desktop Toolbar Quick Guide Screen', 'Background Desktop Companion Preparation Flow', 'Welcome Story Path Intro Reorder', 'Adoption Certificate Badge Perk Incentive']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Predictions were generally too high, though select winning tests (such as sign_in redesign and choose_path layout) were underpredicted.
Sign_in hint changes were helpful, winning 2 tests (rounds 1 and 7).
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 4 tests.
Adoption layout (3 tests) and choose_path redesign (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes showed no clear effect or hurt performance across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, choose_path copy, finish layout, finish copy, finish redesign, home notification, sign_in redesign, adoption redesign, and adoption new_screen (fewer than 2 agreeing tests).

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Grid Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection step with a compact grid layout featuring choice card components for quicker character selection.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in the onboarding funnel at 60.9% and takes a median of 89 seconds.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet archetype to bring to life on your desktop.

candidates.title: Preset Pet Fast Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Add an instant pet avatar selection flow within photo upload to allow users to skip photo rendering issues.
candidates.why: Custom pet rendering fails or creates wrong results for multiple users (3 support tickets), causing adoption drop-off.

upload_photos.headline: Create or Pick Your Pet Avatar
upload_photos.body: Upload a custom pet photo or select one of our curated pet templates.

candidates.title: Story Screen Initial Path Order Adjustment
candidates.change: Reorder the onboarding sequence so users choose their companion path immediately before reading the welcome story.
candidates.why: Choose path takes 8s median but mean time reaches 514s; starting with path choice builds quick momentum.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey
story.body: Discover how your pet lives, plays, and assists right on your screen.

candidates.title: Desktop Shortcut & Docking Setup Screen
candidates.change: Add a new setup screen before completion explaining desktop placement, pet hiding, and screen docking shortcuts.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) report confusion about controlling, hiding, or finding the pet on the desktop.

new_desktop_setup.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_desktop_setup.body: Learn how to move, hide, or talk to your companion from your desktop bar.

candidates.title: Account Recovery Security Headline Copy Update
candidates.change: Update the sign-in screen headline and hint text to emphasize automatic pet data protection and cloud saving.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet & Sync Data
sign_in.body: Linking your account ensures your pet's traits, items, and memory are backed up safely.
sign_in.hint: Signing in secures your pet across app updates and device changes.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Entry Hint Safeguard
candidates.change: Display a helpful hint and companion mascot badge explaining that pet names can be changed anytime later.
candidates.why: Adoption takes median 89s with 60.9% drop-off as users overthink official companion details.

adoption_certificate.hint: Don't worry! You can update your pet's name and details anytime in app settings.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Ready Sound & Alert
candidates.change: Add an optional readiness chime and notification badge on the waiting screen when desktop pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Home wait step has high mean duration (2336s) and users complain about pet not appearing on desktop.

waiting.hint: We will play a sound and alert you when your pet is ready on your desktop.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Animation Companion Display
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot preview and step counter to the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s; visual feedback reduces perceived waiting time.

candidates.title: Split Screen Story Welcome Layout
candidates.change: Change the welcome story screen to a split layout with pet illustration side-by-side with welcome text.
candidates.why: Choose path step has 81% conversion; improving entry appeal sets clearer expectations upfront.

story.headline: Meet Your New Screen Companion
story.body: Your pet lives right on your computer desktop, reacting to your day and keeping you company.

candidates.title: First Day Desktop Pet Reward Checklist
candidates.change: Add a starter reward checklist component on the home intro screen incentivizing initial pet interactions.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 68% and users express confusion about post-setup pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! 3 Quick Things to Try
home_intro.body: Complete your first interactions to claim your companion starter badge.

components.text: 1. Drag pet to your favorite screen corner
2. Double click pet to give a treat
